{{Top}}
[[File:TIEengines-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|The twin ion engine of a TIE fighter]]
The '''twin ion engine''' system was a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] system that was first invented about the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. This form of propulsion was first used in the [[Sith fighter]]s of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would later approve of the same design being used in the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which was developed by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]. A twin ion engine had no moving parts. The "TIE" in TIE fighter refers to the engine.
